paidOutFormula: revenue 187,267 − operating cash flow 21,282 + capex 8,815 (USD millions, as stated)
notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0000037996-26-000015). Revenue includes Ford Credit revenue (13,271). Capex is "Capital spending" (PP&E and tooling); "Acquisitions of finance receivables and operating leases" (55,747, Ford Credit retail loans and the lease fleet) is excluded as financing assets. Wholesale finance receivables are inside operating cash flow (flagged, like Toyota); in 2025 they shrank by 4,992, which raised operating cash flow and so lowers paidOut by that amount. Interest paid is the sum of the two stated figures (Company excluding Ford Credit 1.3bn, Ford Credit 6.7bn), stated in billions; income taxes paid now come from the income-tax note by jurisdiction.
